## At a glance

- **Kind.** Letter.
- **Presented as.** A folded sheet sealed with a smear of tar and marked with a lighthouse.
- **Handed over in.** [[Session 2 - Nib's Tally]], delivered by [[Pell Rushlight]].
- **From.** [[Hobb Tarrow]].

> [!narration] Handout text
> To the three at Reedholt.
>
> The lamp is lit, and I am keeping it. If the bell rings, do not go down alone. The chapel floods fast when the water turns. Take the lantern's light and no one else's.
>
> Ilse Corran knows you are there. Her boats went out at dusk.
>
> H. T.

## Play

The DM hands this over when Pell arrives in [[Session 2 - Nib's Tally]]. It confirms what Nib says about the boats and warns about the tide. The Players are likely to treat it as a deadline and leave at once for the chapel. It says nothing of the ledger, because Hobb does not know where it lies.
